title: Skill frontmatter: the YAML header of a SKILL.md, per the open Agent Skills standard
description: The machine-readable canon of the SKILL.md frontmatter as specified at agentskills.io (the specification itself ships no schema; this file is Lattice's canon of it). A skill is a folder whose SKILL.md carries this header followed by markdown instructions. Unknown fields are permitted — other implementations extend the format — but Lattice ignores them; in particular `allowed-tools` is accepted and deliberately not honored: tool policy is the policy gate's job, never a skill's self-declaration. The `name` must equal the skill's directory name; loaders may fill an absent name from the directory before validating.

name.description: Lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens; no leading/trailing/consecutive hyphens; must match the parent directory name

description.description: What the skill does and when to use it — the only part of a skill that is resident in context, and what the model matches requests against

license.description: License name, or a pointer to a bundled license file

compatibility.description: Environment requirements (target products, system packages, network access)

metadata.description: Free-form key/value pairs (the specification's own examples put author and version here)

allowed-tools.description: Space-separated pre-approved tool list — experimental in the specification, accepted here for compatibility and deliberately ignored by Lattice
